note: Start dates on the start screen. The first is the game's own start; later ones are generated by running the historical game from 1 January 2000 to that date with history followed exactly (src/sim/scenario.ts), so leaders, borders, wars and armed groups are what the data says on that day.

bookmarks.name: New Millennium
bookmarks.description: The world on 1 January 2000: wars in Chechnya, Congo and between Eritrea and Ethiopia, the Taliban ruling most of Afghanistan.

bookmarks.name: Rise of the Caliphate
bookmarks.description: Days after the Islamic State declared a worldwide caliphate in late June 2014, with Mosul taken on 10 June, Russia holding Crimea and war in Donbas.

bookmarks.name: American Dream
bookmarks.description: Donald Trump takes office as the 45th President of the United States on 20 January 2017.
